history_policy: This version hash-inherits every V40 workload, representation, width, job count, checksum, execution mode, scored operation, attribution counter, mixed-tier replay signature, timing boundary, occupancy rule, binary-provenance profile, publication ruling, and schema-v3 memory inventory. It changes no scored row or execution hot path. It versions the tier-attribution sidecar from schema 14 to 15, updates its fail-closed validator, and re-pins the zig-js comparison runner after #975 attached one post-invocation schema-v1 pressure result. Any later workload, boundary, jobs, checksum, metric source, adapter, integration ruling, diagnostic schema, or publication change needs its own version.
change: Adds one schema-v1 Context memory-pressure result to the post-invocation attribution boundary. Configuration and warmup rows carry null; the invocation snapshot, process gauges, checksum, and every scored or replayed counter are captured before pressure runs. The diagnostic validates exact heap/slab reduction and quiescent native-code retirement without entering timing scores or publication decisions.

memory_pressure_diagnostics.reconciliation: before heap and native-code gauges equal the invocation memory and native-code snapshots; after heap and slab gauges cannot increase; live and retired native mappings reach zero or the validator fails
memory_pressure_diagnostics.publication_boundary: The checkpoint runs exactly once after the invocation attribution and process snapshots. Its result does not enter elapsed-time scores, phase deltas, exact allocation replay signatures, performance ratios, stability decisions, or publication acceptance.

exact_parent_integration.publication_boundary: V41 preserves every V40 timing, efficiency, cleanliness, checksum, serial-child, process-classification, provenance, mixed-tier allocation-replay, and memory-inventory gate. The tier-attribution sidecar advances to schema 15 solely for the post-invocation memory-pressure result, which remains diagnostic and outside every scored boundary.

context_lifecycle_integration.publication_boundary: V41 changes only the shared runner hash. Lifecycle scenarios, options, checksums, phase and finalizer reconciliation, plateau policy, measured-boundary occupancy, and evidence ruling are unchanged.

no_jit_integration.publication_boundary: V41 changes only the shared runner hash. Required-bytecode and no-native modes, logical work, checksums, scored attribution, quickening contracts, publication duration, and exact-parent requirements are unchanged.

string_indexing_integration.publication_boundary: V41 changes only the shared runner hash. Every string representation, width, job count, checksum, required-bytecode boundary, scored attribution value, measured-boundary occupancy rule, and exact allocation replay remains unchanged.
